# spawn_onto_blocking behavior in xpcom/rust/moz_task/src/executor.rs

Creates a builder, sets may-block hint, and starts a Send future on the supplied target.

## State read

- name, future, target

## State changed

- new task through builder

## Calls and triggers

- TaskBuilder::new(...).may_block(true).spawn_onto(target); builder bodies read above.

## Result and consumers

AsyncTask<F::Output>; completion means future returned its output, not just dispatch accepted.

## Errors

Underlying dispatch failure is logged; cancelled task may remain Pending. 

## Async completion

Schedules immediately; wrapper supports await, detach and cancellation. May-block is a hint, not proof of I/O pool selection.

## Ownership and cleanup

Moves future to async task; target RefPtr retained for onto variants.

```text
pub fn spawn_onto_blocking<F>(
    name: &'static str,
    target: &nsIEventTarget,
    future: F,
) -> AsyncTask<F::Output>
where
    F: Future + Send + 'static,
    F::Output: Send + 'static,
{
    TaskBuilder::new(name, future)
        .may_block(true)
        .spawn_onto(target)
}
```
